name: Ezreal
title: The Prodigal Explorer

passive.name: Rising Spell Force

description.normalized: Gains 13% Attack Speed for 8 seconds when hitting abilities, stacking up to 4 times.

passive.rawParsedText: Gains 13% Attack Speed for 8 seconds when hitting abilities, stacking up to 4 times.

q.name: Mystic Shot

description.normalized: Fires a bolt, dealing 50 / 85 / 120 / 155 (+135% AD +30% AP) physical damage. Hitting a target reduces Ezreal's other ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds. Applies on-hit effects.

q.rawParsedText: Fires a bolt, dealing 50 / 85 / 120 / 155 (+135% AD +30% AP) physical damage. Hitting a target reduces Ezreal's other ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds. Applies on-hit effects.

w.name: Essence Flux

description.normalized: Fires an orb that sticks to a champion, epic monster or structure for 4 seconds. Hitting the target with an attack or ability detonates the orb, dealing 80 / 155 / 230 / 305 (+60% AD +75% / 80% / 85% / 90% AP) magic damage and refunding 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 Mana.

w.rawParsedText:

e.name: Arcane Shift

description.normalized: Blinks to taget location and fires a bolt, dealing 80 / 145 / 210 / 275 (+50% AD +75% AP) magic damage. Prioritizes enemies hit by Essence Flux, then the nearest enemy.

e.rawParsedText: Blinks to taget location and fires a bolt, dealing 80 / 145 / 210 / 275 (+50% AD +75% AP) magic damage. Prioritizes enemies hit by Essence Flux, then the nearest enemy.

r.name: Trueshot Barrage

description.normalized: Fires an energy wave, dealing 350 / 500 / 650 (+100% AD +90% AP) magic damage. Deals 50% reduced damage to minions and non-epic monsters.
